claim: total assets at Google came to $502 million in the fiscal second quarter of 2025.
summary: Without retrieval the exact Q2 2025 balance sheet cannot be verified, but parametric knowledge establishes Alphabet (Google) total assets have been ~$400-500 billion since 2023 (~$450.3B at Dec 31 2024 and >$470B at Mar 31 2025, crossing ~$500B in H1 2025). A figure of $502 million is ~1000x too low and contradicts known scale; the claim as stated with 'million' is contradicted and reflects a million/billion unit error (true order is ~$502 billion).

sub_claims.text: The reporting entity and line item are total assets of Google/Alphabet Inc.
sub_claims.note: Alphabet routinely reports total assets, but without tools cannot retrieve the specific filing to confirm line-item definition for the period.

sub_claims.text: The fiscal period is the fiscal second quarter of 2025
sub_claims.stated_text: in the fiscal second quarter of 2025
sub_claims.note: Alphabet fiscal year ends Dec 31, so fiscal Q2 2025 is quarter ended June 30 2025; without tools the filing date and period mapping cannot be retrieved and verified.

sub_claims.text: Total assets equaled $502 million at quarter end
sub_claims.note: Scale contradicts established knowledge: Alphabet total assets were $407B at Dec 2023 and $450B at Dec 2024 and near $500B in H1 2025. $502 million is three orders of magnitude too low; reported total assets in Q2 2025 are on order of $502 billion (~502,000 million), indicating a million/billion unit error. Exact dollar amount cannot be pinpointed without tools.
